machine: laptop i7-14650HX, .venv Python 3.14, CPU torch 2.13, onnxruntime 1.29; other tracks' training jobs ran concurrently (system CPU 20-48 %), so timings are upper bounds and vary run to run
protocol: evaluation only: every clip parameter is the docs/8_RASPBERRY_PI5_INTEGRATION.md T1 / ClipConfig default, fixed before the run; nothing was selected or tuned on any video, wa02 included. Replay decisions are stamped at the clip end (compute not added); rows are sampled on the M5 6 Hz grid.

files.replay_all_fastlane.json/.csv: clip mode with the fast lane (YOLO @320 every 4th frame)
files.bench_clip_*.json: live loop, 4 threads pinned to 4 CPUs, 7.mov as the camera
